title: Legal Nemotron Metadata-Only Model Card Proposal

base_model_or_checkpoint.summary: No NaC model checkpoint is selected, trained or published. NVIDIA Nemotron Pretraining Legal v1 is recorded only as a source-candidate reference until source inventory, license/TDM, evaluation and owner-apply gates are complete.

intended_use.summary: Future review artifact for deciding whether a German-law assistant can support controlled notarial workflow analysis after human review. It is not an operational answer system.

prohibited_use.summary: No notarial decision replacement, no legal-truth statement, no automated mandate advice, no source-text storage and no use with mandate data.

source_inventory_summary.summary: Source candidates remain metadata-only. Public legal source access, terms, TDM status and attribution are not approved for ingestion or benchmark generation.

license_tdm_summary.summary: License and TDM review is required before any source-text ingestion, dataset generation, training run or checkpoint release.

data_lineage.summary: The proposal records candidate identifiers and governance references only. It contains no legal source text, publisher text, secrets, personal data or mandate data.

evaluation_summary.summary: No benchmark dataset has been generated and no model evaluation has been executed. Any later quality claim requires an approved benchmark, recorded results and human review.

known_limitations.summary: The proposal cannot prove German-law coverage, answer quality, source completeness, current-law correctness or notarial suitability.

human_review_protocol.summary: A later artifact needs notarial subject-matter review, source-license review, AI governance review and explicit owner apply before runtime use or publication.

ai_sbom_ref.summary: The current AI-SBOM remains the repository baseline. A concrete AI-SBOM delta is required before runtime activation or endpoint use.

owner_apply_ref.summary: No owner apply approval exists for training, evaluation execution, checkpoint publication, endpoint activation or legal-answer quality claims.

no_mandate_data_attestation.summary: This proposal is metadata-only and contains no mandate data, no real personal data, no source full text and no secrets.
